prompt: An independent arithmetic exercise states: A lantern kit has 27 batteries, but 6 batteries are damaged and cannot be used. Each lantern needs 3 usable batteries. Using all the usable batteries from this kit, how many complete lanterns can be powered?
author_note: Only 24->27 total batteries, 4->6 unusable, and 2->3 per lantern change. Subtraction followed by exact division remains the task.
